name: Denmark
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: The climate favors medium bodied, Bordeaux-style reds and slightly earlier-ripening Shiraz.
Mount Barker Chardonnay is closer to Chablis in style.

blurb.text: A subregion of Great Southern, in Western Australia.
